rules.statement: The initial deposit of Rs. 1,072.50 paid by the first defendant was not a mere deposit but an advance payment for hire, and thus cannot be credited to him in case of termination of the hiring agreement.
rules.supporting_quote: "I regret I am unable to accede to this argument. The respective rights of the parties to this agreement have to be determined according to its terms. In my opinion there is sufficient in the terms of this agreement to indicate that this so called 'initial deposit' was nothing more than the payment of a lump hire in advance."
